        Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the
        application depends on the REST extension; Maven resolves the transitive
        APT dependencies below automatically.

        Pre-generates <Resource>$$CassiniAdapter + $$CassiniRoutes at compile
        time (no runtime reflection, AOT-safe). Without this APT, AdapterRegistry
        falls back to RuntimeAdapterGenerator at the first request (JVM-only path
        with a Java Modules warning); functionally OK, but off the nominal codegen path
        documented in cassini/CLAUDE.md (M4).

io.vidocq.runtime.extensions.jakartaee.web:vidocq-runtime-mansart-data-extension-codegen 0.3.0 发布, Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-mansart-data-extension.
        Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the
        application depends on the Mansart Data extension.

        Pulls in:
          - mansart-data-processor : generates _Entity metamodel + *RepositoryImpl
            stubs + META-INF/mansart-repositories.list.
          - mansart-data-cdi       : hosts the BuildCompatibleExtension and the
            @Produces RepositoryRuntime. The APT classloader (isolated by Maven)

io.vidocq.knock:knock-mp-health-api 0.3.0 发布, Re-package of org.eclipse.microprofile.health:microprofile-health-api with an explicit
        module-info.class (module name: microprofile.health.api). The official API only ships an
        Automatic-Module-Name, which prevents its direct use with jlink. This artifact is the sole
        source of the MP Health spec consumed by the Knock modules; the official TCK keeps using
        the upstream API.

        No upstream source file is vendored in this repository: the official .class files are
        unpacked from the upstream binary jar at build time, and the only source we own and compile
        is module-info.java. The upstream META-INF/LICENSE and META-INF/NOTICE are propagated
        verbatim into the produced jar, as required by Apache-2.0 section 4.

items.content_text:
io.vidocq.humboldt:humboldt-otel-interop 0.3.0 发布, OpenTelemetry SDK autoconfigure SPI interoperability layer. Discovers OTel SDK
        autoconfigure providers (ConfigurableSpanExporterProvider, ConfigurableMetricExporterProvider,
        ConfigurableSamplerProvider, ConfigurablePropagatorProvider, ResourceProvider,
        AutoConfigurationCustomizerProvider) via ServiceLoader on a caller-supplied ClassLoader
        and bridges them to the Humboldt SDK. The OTel SDK artifacts are provided-scope: the
        consumer supplies them at runtime (Humboldt itself never bundles the OTel SDK).
